# Onwubiko Goch

> Onwubiko Goch is a digital services professional helping academia, entrepreneurship, and business through writing, virtual assistance, and social media management.

Onwubiko Goch (also known as Goch Onwubiko) is based in Abuja, Nigeria. Grounded in History and International Studies, he combines academic rigor, professional certifications, and creative expertise. He is a qualified historian, professional writer, trained virtual assistant, and skilled social media manager.

He works with scholars, researchers, brands, entrepreneurs, professionals, and organizations worldwide.

## Client Process
